summary: Completed frontend testing of NeXify Next.js app refinements: AIFly chat panel bottom lighting fix and hero video widening. Chat open/close functionality verified, hero video confirmed as wide landscape format with autoplay, responsive design working across all breakpoints (1920/1280/820/390px), no horizontal overflow detected. Panel bottom lime glow successfully contained with refined box-shadow. Orientation chat UI elements present but full functionality limited by /api/session being out of scope.

integration_issues.issue: /api/session returns 404, preventing full orientation chat functionality testing
integration_issues.impact: Cannot verify orientation chat produces local recommendation results as intended
integration_issues.note: Main agent specified shop/auth APIs are out of scope. Orientation chat UI elements (starter chips, textarea, send button) are present and clickable, but backend integration cannot be fully tested.

design_issues.issue: CSS specifies aspect-ratio: 16/10 but computed style shows 6/5 (1.2 ratio)
design_issues.impact: Video is landscape and visibly wider as intended, but actual aspect ratio differs from CSS specification
design_issues.note: Video is correctly landscape (wider than tall) and has been widened per requirements. The aspect ratio variance may be due to grid constraints or container queries. Visual result is acceptable.
